normalized.result:
The basic search feels right: it finds matches across all the useful information and ignores capitalization. I don’t need separate field-by-field search.

Matching all selected tag chips is the behavior I’d expect when narrowing the list. For more complicated searches, though, I’d also want to type tags directly as `#tag`, search an exact phrase in quotes, and combine terms with AND, OR, NOT, and parentheses.

The press-Enter tag input feels fine, but it should suggest existing tags as I type. That would help me reuse the same spelling instead of accidentally creating nearly identical tags.
